heading: INT. STALLED ELEVATOR, GRANDVIEW HOTEL - DAY

units.text: INT. STALLED ELEVATOR, GRANDVIEW HOTEL - DAY
A mirrored box, brass rails.
A tiered wedding cake in a white box sits on a luggage cart in the center.
The floor indicator is stuck between 14 and 15.
BARTHOLOMEW "BART" KWIATKOWSKI, fifties, pastry chef in whites, grips the cart with both hands.
YOLANDA PRICE, thirties, the wedding planner, in a headset and heels, stabs the alarm button.
CHEN WEI, twenties, the bellhop, leans against the rail eating a granola bar.
FIONNUALA DOYLE, sixties, the bride's grandmother, sits on a folding stool she has brought from somewhere, knitting.
Okay. Everyone remain calm.
units.name: YOLANDA

units.text: I am calm. This cake is not calm.
units.name: BART

units.text: It's a cake.
units.name: CHEN

units.text: It is forty-eight hours of fondant.
units.name: BART

units.text: The elevator shudders.
The cake tiers slide an inch.
Bart and Yolanda lunge at the same time and bump foreheads.
Ow!
units.name: YOLANDA

units.text: Ow!
units.name: BART

units.text: Fionnuala keeps knitting.
Always the same with the young. You rush and then you bleed.
units.name: FIONNUALA

units.text: The ceremony starts in thirty minutes.
units.name: YOLANDA

units.text: I can call someone.
units.name: CHEN

units.text: Please do.
units.name: YOLANDA

units.text: He pulls a walkie-talkie from his belt, presses the key, and hears only static.
He taps it against his palm.
Bart watches the cake like a man watching a cliff.
Don't tilt. Don't tilt.
units.name: BART

units.text: Chen, dear, is there a phone number on the wall?
units.name: FIONNUALA

units.text: Yes, ma'am.
units.name: CHEN

units.text: Then why on earth aren't we using it?
units.name: FIONNUALA

units.text: Everyone turns to the wall.
A small door in the panel reads EMERGENCY PHONE.
Yolanda yanks it open.
Inside is a handset and a sticker: OUT OF ORDER.
Of course.
units.name: YOLANDA

units.text: The elevator drops two inches.
The cake slides.
Bart and Chen and Yolanda all dive for it, and the three of them end up in a pile on top of the cart, holding the box together like a family hugging.
Fionnuala turns a row on her needles and does not look up.
Well. That's one way to do it.
units.name: FIONNUALA
